en: • A commuter train representing the Hankyu Shinpo Line. The base is 9300 series.
• The actual train consists of 8 cars.
• Both the lead car and the middle car can be made with or without a pantograph by selecting the roof plate.
• A single arm type pantograph is included.
• Sticker included. *6 sets of products are required to create an 8-car train.
・Compatible with power unit 3 ・Compatible with running trolley T ・Contains 2 cars
